# prompt-injection-guard

> Offline first-line screen for prompt injection in user input and retrieved content, with explainable weighted rules, Unicode obfuscation removal including tag characters, and an optional classifier that can only raise the score. Python package `trysac-prompt-injection-guard`, import name `prompt_injection_guard`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
